_comment: Per-package gzipped-size budgets in bytes. Measured against the ESM entry graph: dist/index.js plus every relative file it reaches, gzipped together, so a package that code-splits is still measured on what importing it costs. Tune up explicitly when a primitive batch lands; tune down when a refactor genuinely shrinks output. NOTE on @usemotif/icons: the dist barrel re-exports 1,933 lucide-derived glyphs; the budget reflects the full-barrel size, but real consumers tree-shake to ~100 B gz per imported icon (sideEffects: false guarantees it). Lowered once when lucide's aliases became re-exports of their target glyph instead of duplicate copies of it. NOTE on @usemotif/headless: raised twice while the package moved to a directive-free entry over a client chunk, first by 408 gzipped bytes and then by 356 more as that entry took over assembling all 17 compound namespaces. Both increases are the entry alone; across the second one the client chunk holding the components actually shrank by 146 bytes. Import cost fell at the same time, because a namespace built from plain bindings tree-shakes where an object of components did not: the Dialog-only and Tooltip-only targets in check-tree-shaking.mjs dropped by 14 and 24 percent. NOTE on @usemotif/headless, later: raised from 26100 to 28021 for date range selection on Calendar and DatePicker and for the shared menu level and submenu parts, net of ContextMenu's duplicate item, which went in the same change. Raised again from 28021 to 29885 for async Combobox states, promise toasts, the touch long-press, checkbox and radio menu items, and swipe-to-dismiss; useDrag itself lives in @usemotif/react and is not counted here. Raised again from 29885 to 31498 for the new Toggle and ToggleGroup. Raised again from 31498 to 33686 for TagsInput. Raised again from 33686 to 34100 for windowed option lists (spacers, scroll sync and highlight follow in the shared listbox rows). Raised again from 34100 to 34500 for RangeSlider pointer drag on the web track. Raised again from 34500 to 35000 for Toast placement, pause on hover and focus, and renderToast. Raised again from 35000 to 35500 for Calendar minDate, maxDate and numberOfMonths on web. Raised again from 35500 to 35800 for Tooltip.Provider. NOTE on @usemotif/compiler-core: raised from 7374 to 7450 when four more state props (_invalid, _pressed, _focusWithin, _readOnly) joined its emit order and strip rules. Raised again from 7450 to 7550, and @usemotif/core from 19208 to 19400, for the group states (_groupHover, _groupFocus, _groupActive), the group marker, and responsive values inside state bags. @usemotif/core raised again from 19400 to 20300, and @usemotif/react from 28100 to 28200, for responsive styled() variant values (resolveResponsiveVariants). NOTE on usemotif: raised from 590 when both entries began re-exporting every name the two platform packages share (24 were missing), which the entry's own re-export list pays for. NOTE on @usemotif/react-native: raised from 27495 when Box gained keyframe animation (the stop sampler, CSS timing model and frame clock), an entry-graph growth of about 2.1 KB. NOTE on @usemotif/react: raised from 27909 to 28100 for Input adornments (startElement / endElement). Raised again from 28200 to 28600 for TextArea autoResize (field-sizing plus the measured fallback). Raised again from 28600 to 28900 for ScrollView onEndReached. NOTE on @usemotif/react, @usemotif/reset and @usemotif/migrate: these emit shared chunks alongside their entry, so their budgets were raised once to cover the whole graph rather than the entry fragment they used to be compared against. @usemotif/headless raised from 35800 to 36000 for FileUpload maxSize, maxFiles and onReject. @usemotif/headless raised from 36000 to 36200 for non-modal Dialog. @usemotif/headless raised from 36200 to 36700 for overlay arrows. @usemotif/headless raised from 36700 to 37000 for option groups. @usemotif/headless raised from 37000 to 37300 for interactive Stepper. @usemotif/headless raised from 37300 to 38000 for ColorPicker swatches and eyedropper. @usemotif/react raised from 28900 to 29200 for IconProvider. @usemotif/headless raised from 38000 to 38200 for Pagination boundaries and page size. @usemotif/headless raised from 38200 to 38700 for CommandPalette nested pages. @usemotif/recipes raised from 1313 to 1500 for cardRecipe interactive variant. @usemotif/recipes raised from 1500 to 1600 for chipRecipe selected variant. @usemotif/react raised from 29200 to 29400 for the style cache's realm-shared state (one cache and collector across entry points). @usemotif/headless raised from 38700 to 39300 for useShortcut (matching, input filtering, platform labels). @usemotif/headless raised from 39300 to 42200 for DataTable. @usemotif/react raised from 29400 to 30200 for Presence (keyed enter and exit) and Box layoutId. @usemotif/react-native raised from 30491 to 31400 for Presence (keyed enter and exit) and Box layoutId. @usemotif/migrate raised from 566 to 5000 for the from-styled-components and from-tamagui codemods (a dev-time CLI package; @babel/parser stays an external dependency). @usemotif/migrate raised from 5000 to 7400 for import-tokens, the W3C Design Tokens importer (its scale and font-weight name tables). @usemotif/react raised from 30200 to 32100 for CSS scroll-driven animation (the timeline compiler useScroll and useTransform pull in). @usemotif/react raised from 32100 to 33000 for Form (native constraint validation and React 19 actions). @usemotif/react raised from 33000 to 33400 for TitleBar. @usemotif/react-native raised from 31400 to 31600 for TitleBar. @usemotif/react raised from 33400 to 33800 for the shared Box resolver behind @usemotif/react/rsc. @usemotif/react raised from 33800 to 34100 for styledSlots. @usemotif/react-native raised from 31600 to 31800 for styledSlots. @usemotif/core raised from 20300 to 20400 for the @usemotif/core/tailwind entry (the modules it shares with the barrel now load from a split chunk).
